_doc: Multi-component manifest: declares sibling repo roots the ai-dev enforcer may widen the boundary to (PROTOCOL.md invariant 2 · docs/architecture.md ## Components). Operator-authorized read+write to the CYNTRON/cloud sibling for the cross-repo Phase-C mTLS work (2026-07-18).

components.name: cloud
components.description: SA-02m cloud backend (frps + stdlib API + fleet UI). Device-side seam: docs/contracts/cloud-enrollment.md.

components.name: mr02m
components.description: MR-02m RS-485 I/O module firmware (STM32). READ-REFERENCE for the BACnet MS/TP web-integration planning (Operator 2026-08-05): owns the module's Modbus register map, .fw format, and its BACnet implementation/scripts. Its docs/agent-rules/mp02m-domain.md is the domain home — web-side rendering follows the module's map, never invents one.

components.name: dtv
components.description: DTV temperature/humidity sensor firmware. READ-REFERENCE for BACnet MS/TP planning (Operator 2026-08-05): carries BACNET_VARIABLES.txt and the device's BACnet object model/scripts.

components.name: ce02m3
components.description: CE-02m-3 network analyzer (power meter) firmware. READ-REFERENCE for BACnet MS/TP planning (Operator 2026-08-05): its BACnet object model and register map.

components.name: mr02m-flasher
components.description: Standalone MR-02m module flasher (Python). READ-REFERENCE for BACnet MS/TP planning (Operator 2026-08-05): carries BACnet work scripts alongside the flash protocol.

components.name: hardpy_tests
components.description: HardPy production/bench test-stand harness sharing physical devices with SA-02m-web-build (192.168.10.136 = stand SA02M-136). Deploys its own analytics/test-runner web app (/var/www/hardpy_stand, separate from network_config) and reads the RS-485 verifier modules on COM4 through THIS project's sa02m-modbus-mqtt bridge (verifier_via_mqtt=true, hardpy.toml.sa02m) — so a stale/broken bridge on a shared stand breaks hardpy_tests too. DUT flashing during test runs uses its OWN standalone flasher (/opt/MR-02m-flasher, flasher_path in hardpy.toml.sa02m), NOT this project's opt/sa02m-flasher web-integrated one. Version pin for the expected SA-02m-web-build deploy on each shared stand: docs/SA02M_WEB_BUILD_PIN.md in that repo. Added 2026-07-28 (flasher-signature feature) after discovering 192.168.10.136 was manually SSH-patched with no tracked version expectation.

components.name: fast-modbus-driver
components.description: Fast Modbus driver for MasterSCADA4D / MPLC4 (the CyntronProtocol FB). SOURCE of half of the device's mplc_cyntron.so. Declared 2026-08-14 (Operator) to build it as a SEPARATE driver and debug the SIGSEGV the combined patched 483KB driver caused on FB load (bench 192.168.1.136).

components.name: pca9536-driver
components.description: PCA9536 I2C expander driver for MasterPLC/MPLC4. SOURCE of the other half of the device's mplc_cyntron.so. Declared 2026-08-14 (Operator) to build it as a SEPARATE driver and debug the combined-driver SIGSEGV on bench 192.168.1.136.
